content:
RevenueCat's annual Shipaton mobile app hackathon is officially back, running from August 1 to September 30, with winning apps eligible for generous prizes. Here are the details.

Shipaton 2026 is now underway, with the competition closing on September 30 and winning apps eligible for generous prizes.

Have you ever thought about developing an app? Until recently, app development was still considered a daunting task, something only experienced programmers could do. But with the rise of AI coding tools, anyone can now easily build and launch a great app, no experience required.

To encourage and nurture the next wave of app development, RevenueCat has just launched its annual Shipaton competition, the world's largest mobile app hackathon.

The rules are simple: as long as you launch a brand-new app between August 1 and September 30, and use the RevenueCat SDK to monetize it, you're eligible to enter.

Total cash prizes exceed US$700,000, with the total value of all prizes reaching over US$1 million. There are 20 competition categories, including a dedicated "Student Prize".

Winning apps will also be featured on a billboard in New York's Times Square, and winners will be invited to attend a red carpet event in New York to receive their awards on stage.

You can sign up here to participate in this year's Shipaton.

All participants will receive a "Ship Kit" after signing up, which includes coupons, discounts and credits to help them successfully launch and grow their apps.

In addition, twice-weekly livestream sessions will feature RevenueCat staff and industry experts sharing insights to help participants master the art of building and running a mobile app business.

You can also meet other participants at over 40 "Shipaton IRL" in-person events worldwide.

For full details, visit shipaton.com, where you can sign up to participate.
